methodology.real_score: |H_ir| / (|H_ii - H_rr| + eps), with r chosen as the minimum-diagonal-energy determinant
methodology.null_control: Permutation of the REAL score values across determinant identities
methodology.random_baseline: Uniform random ranking of all 70 determinants

G5_practical_reduction.reason: v50_2 records K-budget performance, but the final preregistered reference-quality threshold is frozen/evaluated in the later efficiency stage.

G6_reproducibility.note: No selective seed removal is performed. Formal conclusion stability is evaluated from the complete stored seed-level table.

interpretation_boundary.claim_scope: v50_2 tests a first molecular REAL-vs-NULL ranking proxy. It does not yet establish industrial utility or general molecular transfer.
